finalText:
**Big but shallow.** 1082 hits in 94 files. Roughly 1028 of them, in 75 service files, are safe internal renames.

Four places must not be renamed:

| Where | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | Public contract. Rename needs a new dated version. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/src/` | 4 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | Already applied. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | Right side is the wire name. Key may change, value may not. |

The real trap is SQL text in the 25 `repo/*.js` files. `WHERE account_id = ?` is a DB column, not a variable. A blind find-replace breaks every query.

Sign off only if the change is variables and params, plus a column rename migration if they want the DB moved too.
